slides.body: AI shows up in your work in two places, and people mix them up. One question tells them apart: if the API key is switched off tomorrow, does the product stop, or do you just type more?

slides.heading: THE CHECK
slides.body: The last trip crosses midnight. The model copies 00:05 from the timetable: well formed, plausible, wrong. Five lines of code notice and send it back.
slides.code:
QUESTION  last trip of 5A
model  asks read_timetable
model  proposes
  23:40, 23:47, 00:05
code   rejected
  23:47 before 00:05
model  proposes
  23:40, 23:47, 24:05
code   accepted

slides.statement: THE CHECK COSTS NOTHING. BEING WRONG COSTS MONEY.

slides.heading: WHAT IT COSTS
slides.body: Output costs five times input. And the whole conversation is resent every round, so the input grows although the question never changed.

slides.heading: RAG
slides.body: Not a separate architecture. Replace read_timetable with search and you have RAG. The weak link is retrieval, not generation.
